2026-11-07.headline: SharePoint site skills guide now details creation, permissions, and lifecycle controls
2026-11-07.overview: The period brought one documentation update for Copilot in SharePoint. The revised guidance explains how site owners manage site skills from Settings > Site skills, including their storage, ownership, permissions, and lifecycle operations.
2026-11-07.adminImpact: Site owners can use the documented management page and controls to administer site skills. No action is required.

keyChanges.title: Site skills management guidance expanded
keyChanges.detail: The Copilot in SharePoint article now documents creating and managing site skills from Settings > Site skills, including uploading, editing, enabling, disabling, copying, restoring, downloading, and deleting them. It also clarifies storage, ownership, and permissions.

2026-11-09.headline: Sensitivity-labeled PDFs gain web annotation in OneDrive and SharePoint in January 2027
2026-11-09.overview: OneDrive for Business and SharePoint on the web are scheduled to let users with editing rights annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs without removing their labels. Saved files will retain both annotations and protections, with worldwide rollout planned for late January 2027.
2026-11-09.adminImpact: No admin action is required. Administrators should note that the capability applies only to OneDrive for Business and SharePoint and is intended for users with editing rights.

keyChanges.title: Editing rights will include annotation of protected PDFs
keyChanges.detail: Users with editing rights will be able to annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs on the web without removing the labels. Annotations and protections will be preserved when the file is saved; worldwide rollout is planned for late January 2027.

2026-11-02.headline: Unified Copilot Search and group-permission governance reporting headline SharePoint administration
2026-11-02.overview: Two Message Center announcements carry the period: SharePoint Online and OneDrive for the web are moving to a unified Copilot Search experience, with preview rollout beginning in mid-October 2026 and general rollout in mid-January 2027; SharePoint’s Data access governance report for group permissions is scheduled to roll out worldwide from late November to early December. A separate Agents and Copilot article now documents the full site-skills management workflow.
2026-11-02.adminImpact: Copilot Search requires minimal organizational action, and users can opt out during preview. Administrators can use the forthcoming report in the admin center to find sites accessible to particular groups and assess access levels, supporting permission reviews and checks for unintended content exposure. Site owners can administer skills from Settings > Site skills using the documented controls; the article states that no action is required.

keyChanges.title: Copilot Search unifies SharePoint Online and OneDrive web search
keyChanges.detail: The updated experience adds natural-language prompts, AI summaries, and filters. The announced schedule places preview rollout from mid-October 2026 and general rollout from mid-January 2027; users can opt out during preview and organizational action is minimal.
keyChanges.product: SharePoint Online and OneDrive for the web

keyChanges.title: Data access governance report adds group-permission visibility
keyChanges.detail: The new report in the SharePoint admin center will help administrators identify sites accessible to specific groups and assess their access levels. Worldwide rollout is scheduled from late November to early December 2026, supporting permission management and efforts to prevent unintended content exposure.

keyChanges.title: Site skills management is documented under Settings > Site skills
keyChanges.detail: The updated article explains how to create and manage site skills, including uploading, editing, enabling, disabling, copying, restoring, downloading, and deleting them. It also clarifies storage, ownership, and permissions, giving site owners a documented management path.

2026-11-09.headline: OneDrive and SharePoint will let editors annotate protected PDFs without removing labels
2026-11-09.overview: Microsoft announced a worldwide rollout planned for late January 2027 that will let users with editing rights annotate sensitivity-label-protected PDFs on the web. Annotations and protections will remain intact when the file is saved. The capability applies to OneDrive for Business and SharePoint.
2026-11-09.adminImpact: No administrator action is required. Administrators should note the late-January 2027 rollout and its scope: web-based annotation is limited to users with editing rights on OneDrive for Business and SharePoint files.

keyChanges.title: Web annotation for sensitivity-label-protected PDFs
keyChanges.detail: Users with editing rights will be able to annotate sensitivity-label-protected PDFs in OneDrive for Business and SharePoint without removing the labels; both annotations and protections are preserved when the file is saved. Worldwide rollout is planned for late January 2027, with no admin action required.

2026-11.headline: Unified Copilot Search and group-permission reporting lead SharePoint’s November roadmap
2026-11.overview: Microsoft announced a unified Copilot Search experience for SharePoint Online and OneDrive on the web, with natural-language prompts, AI summaries, and filters. A SharePoint Data access governance report for group permissions is rolling out from late November to early December 2026, while protected-PDF annotation is planned for late January 2027. Separately, Microsoft expanded the documented management workflow for SharePoint site skills.
2026-11.adminImpact: Copilot Search requires minimal organizational action, and users can opt out during preview; general rollout is planned for mid-January 2027. Administrators can use the permissions report to review sites accessible to particular groups and assess access levels. No administrator action is required for protected-PDF annotation or the site-skills documentation update; site owners can manage skills from Settings > Site skills.

keyChanges.title: Unified Copilot Search is rolling across SharePoint and OneDrive for the web

Preview rollout began in mid-October 2026, with general rollout planned for mid-January 2027. Users can opt out during preview, and Microsoft says minimal organizational action is required.

keyChanges.title: SharePoint is adding a group-permission Data access governance report
keyChanges.detail: The admin center report will identify sites accessible to specific groups and show access levels, helping administrators review permissions and detect unintended content exposure. Worldwide rollout is scheduled from late November to early December 2026.
